# Xodus Nexus backend 0.2.16

A small backend update with one fix.

## Store licensing

- When a game requests it, the backend now forwards the genuine Store acquisition data for items the active account owns, together with the verified license token.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Xodus Nexus is an independent, unofficial project built on Xodus. It is not an official project or release from the upstream Xodus developers.**
>
> Please report issues only in the [Xodus Nexus repository](https://github.com/domsvoboda/xodus-nexus/issues). A problem in Xodus Nexus does not necessarily indicate a problem in upstream Xodus.
